'''Kom Orda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and Field Cannoneer who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Orda led [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces in the [[Brell Sediment]] until they encountered an Imperial spacer and were defeated.
